title: Mobile Menu Link Row
description: Full-width divider row for a plain link inside the mobile navigation drawer (parts/mobile-menu.html), matching the height/typography/vertical rhythm of the drawer's accordion rows (styles/blocks/details/mobile-menu-accordion.json). No margin override — the accordion rows get their inter-row spacing purely from the theme's default blockGap (settings.spacing.blockGap, styles/presets/spacing.json, spacing--30) on the wrapping .mobile-menu group's flow layout; this style used to zero that same margin out and rely on an ad-hoc per-instance padding-top instead, which is exactly the arbitrary-value drift this style exists to prevent.
